tools.name: kvittia_get_company
tools.description: Get the Kvittia company behind the API key: name, org number, plan (paket), the services in the plan, and the key's name and permission. Good first call. API: GET /bolag.

tools.name: kvittia_list_references
tools.description: List the allowed categories, VAT rates, payment methods and statuses for receipts. Use these exact values when you upload or change a receipt. API: GET /referens.

tools.name: kvittia_list_receipts
tools.description: List the company's receipts, newest first, with amount, VAT, category, account and status. Filter by date, status, category or text. Use uppdaterad_efter to sync changes. API: GET /kvitton.

tools.name: kvittia_get_receipt
tools.description: Get one receipt: store, date, amount, VAT, net, category, account, status, uploader and the matched bank transaction. API: GET /kvitton/{id}.

tools.name: kvittia_list_suppliers
tools.description: Search the supplier register by name or organisation number. Returns bank and payment details. API: GET /leverantorer.

tools.name: kvittia_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices with approval status (granska, godkand, betald) and payment status. Needs the supplier-invoices service. API: GET /leverantorsfakturor.

tools.name: kvittia_get_supplier_invoice
tools.description: Get one supplier invoice: invoice number, OCR, dates, amount, VAT, bank details, status and category. Needs the supplier-invoices service. API: GET /leverantorsfakturor/{id}.

tools.name: kvittia_list_customer_invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices from the connected invoicing system, with whether each is paid (matched to a deposit). Needs the customer-invoices service. API: GET /kundfakturor.

tools.name: kvittia_list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List bank statement lines and the receipt or invoice each one is matched to. matched=false returns lines with no supporting document. Needs the bank reconciliation service. API: GET /transaktioner.

tools.name: kvittia_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices and credit notes created in Kvittia: status, customer, dates, amount and due status. Personal numbers are never returned. Needs the invoicing service. API: GET /fakturor.

tools.name: kvittia_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id or invoice number: customer, lines, VAT, totals, payment status and the PDF link. Needs the invoicing service. API: GET /fakturor/{id}.

tools.name: kvittia_lookup_company
tools.description: Look up ONE Swedish company by organisation number: registration, SNI codes, latest financial figures and Kvittia's risk analysis. Single lookups only; no bulk lists. Needs the company-search service. API: GET /foretag/{orgnr}.

tools.name: kvittia_upload_receipt
tools.description: Upload a receipt file (JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB, sent as base64). By default Kvittia reads store, date, amount, VAT and category from the file. Set las_av=false and give the fields yourself to skip reading. A duplicate returns HTTP 409 with the existing id. API: POST /kvitton.

tools.name: kvittia_update_receipt
tools.description: Change a receipt's status (ny, bokford = booked, avvisad = rejected), category, account, payment method or note. Give at least one field. Mark a receipt bokford after it is booked in the accounting system. API: PATCH /kvitton/{id}.
